title: Release Momentum Sequence
description: A music-video launch sequence establishing one thumbnail identity and extending it into teaser, premiere, and clip-card surfaces.
creative_direction: The root image defines one high-clarity video-thumbnail world with a performer, a cinematic scene hook, and modular promo zones. The following images preserve the same subject and release-world grammar while adapting intensity and hierarchy for adjacent launch cards.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-reference-video-thumbnail first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-premiere-card-variant, 03-teaser-still-variant, 04-clip-drop-variant. Queue may run 02-premiere-card-variant, 03-teaser-still-variant, 04-clip-drop-variant concurrently after 01-reference-video-thumbnail is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
